title: A change sent to a work order invoiced in another tab is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}; it is ready to invoice.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide. {Work-order-1} is also open in a second tab of the same browser
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the first tab, click the Sales Representative field so the dropdown is open.
  2. In the second tab, invoice {Work-order-1}.
  3. Back in the first tab, without reloading, click {Sales-rep-B}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the dropdown is open.
  • Step 2: the invoice is created.
  • Step 3: the change is refused with the message "The sales representative cannot be changed on an invoiced or paid work order." and the field returns to {Sales-rep-A}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative); story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S2-E4, S1-N1, User Feedback Summary, a change sent to an invoiced or paid work order, read 19 Oct 2026. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-E4: “Changing a representative after the work order is invoiced or paid is not offered. A change sent by any other route is refused with "The sales representative cannot be changed on an invoiced or paid work order." The invoice keeps the names captured when it was created (Story 5). Reversing the invoice unlocks the field again, and the next invoice captures the names afresh.”
  • S1-N1: “A user without 'Work Orders — Create & Edit', or a work order that is invoiced, paid or opened from its history, shows the field as plain text with the same label and wording, with no + or remove x. If a change is sent by any other route, the system refuses it.”
  • User Feedback Summary, a change sent to an invoiced or paid work order: “Error message; the field returns to the saved value”
